```{r}

###############################################
# FUNCTION TO GENERATE VIOLIN PLOT + STATS
###############################################
plot_violin_and_test <- function(var_name) {
  
  df <- data.frame(
    Parameter = c(Chemo_data[[var_name]], Chemo_immu_data[[var_name]]),
    Treatment = rep(c("C", "C&I"),
                times = c(nrow(Chemo_data), nrow(Chemo_immu_data)))
  )
  
  # Determine test automatically based on normality
  if (shapiro.test(df$Parameter[df$Treatment=="C"])$p.value > 0.05 &&
      shapiro.test(df$Parameter[df$Treatment=="C&I"])$p.value > 0.05) {
    stat_test <- t.test(Parameter ~ Treatment, data = df)
    test_used <- "t-test"
  } else {
    stat_test <- wilcox.test(Parameter ~ Treatment, data = df)
    test_used <- "Wilcoxon"
  }

  pval <- stat_test$p.value
  p_label <- ifelse(pval < 0.001, "***",
                    ifelse(pval < 0.01, "**",
                           ifelse(pval < 0.05, "*", "ns")))
  
  p_title <- paste0(var_name, " (p-value = ",
                    signif(pval, 2), ")")
  
  g <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Treatment, y = Parameter, fill = Treatment)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white") +
    ggtitle(p_title) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = max(df$Parameter, na.rm = TRUE),
             label = p_label, size = 8) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 0, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) 
  
  return(g)
}
```

#### Plot Violin Stratifies comparisons by **Survival status** (`pCR` vs `RD`)

```{r}

###############################################
# ENSURE SURVIVAL COLUMN IS FACTOR

Chemo_data$Survival <- factor(Chemo_data$Survival, levels = c("pCR", "RD"))
Chemo_immu_data$Survival <- factor(Chemo_immu_data$Survival, levels = c("pCR", "RD"))

```


```{r}

plot_violin_stratified <- function(var_name) {

  df <- bind_rows(
    Chemo_data %>%
      dplyr::select(Survival, value = all_of(var_name)) %>%
      mutate(Treatment = "C"),
    
    Chemo_immu_data %>%
      dplyr::select(Survival, value = all_of(var_name)) %>%
      mutate(Treatment = "C&I")
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value))
  ###############################################
  # STATISTICAL TEST PER STRATUM
  ###############################################
  stat_results <- df %>%
    group_by(Survival) %>%
    summarise(
      p_norm_chemo =
        shapiro.test(value[Treatment == "C"])$p.value,
      p_norm_immu =
        shapiro.test(value[Treatment == "C&I"])$p.value,
      test_used = ifelse(
        p_norm_chemo > 0.05 & p_norm_immu > 0.05,
        "t-test",
        "Wilcoxon"
      ),
      p_value = ifelse(
        test_used == "t-test",
        t.test(value ~ Treatment)$p.value,
        wilcox.test(value ~ Treatment, exact = FALSE)$p.value
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      label = case_when(
        p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      )
    )

  ###############################################
  # CREATE VIOLIN PLOT
  ###############################################
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Treatment, y = value, fill = Treatment)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA) +
    facet_wrap(~ Survival, scales = "free_y") +
    geom_text(
      data = stat_results,
      aes(
        x = 1.5,
        y = max(df$value, na.rm = TRUE),
        label = label
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 4
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(var_name, ": C vs C&I"),
      y = var_name,
      x = NULL
    ) +
    guides(fill = "none") +                # <-- removes fill legend
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",            # <-- removes legend entirely
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 0, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
}
```

#### Using Volcano plot

```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Load data
# ------------------------------------------------------------
Chemo_data <- read_excel("saved_data/Chemo_model_for_box_plot_New.xlsx")
Chemo_immu_data <- read_excel("saved_data/Chemo_immuno__model_for_box_plot_New.xlsx")


```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Add labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------
Chemo_data <- Chemo_data %>%
  mutate(
    Survival  = factor(Survival, levels = c("pCR", "RD")),
    Treatment = "Chemo"
  )

Chemo_immu_data <- Chemo_immu_data %>%
  mutate(
    Survival  = factor(Survival, levels = c("pCR", "RD")),
    Treatment = "Chemo-IO"
  )

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Get numeric parameter columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------
id_cols <- c("Patient", "Survival", "Treatment")

get_param_cols <- function(df, id_cols) {
  num_cols <- names(df)[vapply(df, is.numeric, logical(1))]
  setdiff(num_cols, id_cols)
}

param_cols_chemo <- get_param_cols(Chemo_data, id_cols)
param_cols_io    <- get_param_cols(Chemo_immu_data, id_cols)
all_vars <- union(param_cols_chemo, param_cols_io)

if (length(all_vars) == 0) stop("No numeric parameter columns found.")

add_missing_cols <- function(df, cols) {
  miss <- setdiff(cols, names(df))
  if (length(miss) > 0) df[miss] <- NA_real_
  df
}

Chemo_data      <- add_missing_cols(Chemo_data, all_vars)
Chemo_immu_data <- add_missing_cols(Chemo_immu_data, all_vars)

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Long format
# ------------------------------------------------------------
combined <- bind_rows(Chemo_data, Chemo_immu_data)

long_df <- combined %>%
  dplyr::select(Survival, Treatment, all_of(all_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(all_vars),
    names_to = "Parameter",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value), is.finite(Value))

```

```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Helper functions
# ------------------------------------------------------------
safe_shapiro_p <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  if (length(unique(x)) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  tryCatch(shapiro.test(x)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
}

classify_parameter <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    grepl("^Gr_", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Growth rate",
    grepl("^In_", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Inhibition rate",
    grepl("^(Slope_|intercept_|TIS_|TGR_|TDS_)", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Dynamic feature",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

compute_volcano_stats_pCR_vs_RD <- function(df_treat) {
  df_treat %>%
    group_by(Parameter) %>%
    summarise(
      n_pCR = sum(Survival == "pCR"),
      n_RD  = sum(Survival == "RD"),

      mean_pCR = mean(Value[Survival == "pCR"], na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_RD  = mean(Value[Survival == "RD"],  na.rm = TRUE),

      min_all = min(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
      offset  = ifelse(min_all <= 0, abs(min_all) + 1, 0),

      # positive log2FC means higher in pCR
      log2FC = log2((mean_pCR + offset + 1e-6) / (mean_RD + offset + 1e-6)),

      p_norm_pCR = safe_shapiro_p(Value[Survival == "pCR"]),
      p_norm_RD  = safe_shapiro_p(Value[Survival == "RD"]),

      test_used = case_when(
        !is.na(p_norm_pCR) & !is.na(p_norm_RD) &
          p_norm_pCR > 0.05 & p_norm_RD > 0.05 ~ "t-test",
        TRUE ~ "Wilcoxon"
      ),

      p_value = case_when(
        n_pCR < 2 | n_RD < 2 ~ NA_real_,
        test_used == "t-test" ~ tryCatch(t.test(Value ~ Survival)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
        TRUE ~ tryCatch(wilcox.test(Value ~ Survival, exact = FALSE)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
      FDR_plot = pmax(FDR, 1e-300),
      negLog10FDR = -log10(FDR_plot),
      class = classify_parameter(Parameter)
    )
}

```

```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Compute volcano stats WITHIN each treatment arm
# ------------------------------------------------------------
volcano_stats <- long_df %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  group_modify(~ compute_volcano_stats_pCR_vs_RD(.x)) %>%
  ungroup()

```

```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7) Significance cutoffs
# ------------------------------------------------------------
alpha_fdr <- 0.10
fc_cut <- log2(0.11)

volcano_stats <- volcano_stats %>%
  mutate(
    is_sig = !is.na(FDR) & FDR < alpha_fdr & abs(log2FC) >= fc_cut,
    plot_class = ifelse(is_sig, class, "Not significant")
  )

```

```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8) Common axis limits for direct comparison
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plot_df_all <- volcano_stats %>%
  filter(is.finite(log2FC), is.finite(negLog10FDR))

x_lim <- max(abs(plot_df_all$log2FC), na.rm = TRUE)
x_lim <- max(x_lim, fc_cut) * 1.15

y_lim <- max(plot_df_all$negLog10FDR, na.rm = TRUE)
y_lim <- max(y_lim, -log10(alpha_fdr)) * 1.10

```

```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9) High-impact plot function
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plot_volcano_highimpact <- function(stats_df, title = NULL, subtitle = NULL, label_top_n = 15) {

  plot_df <- stats_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(log2FC), is.finite(negLog10FDR))

  lab_df <- plot_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(is_sig) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(FDR, dplyr::desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = label_top_n)

  # add a little extra top room for the corner annotations
  y_lim_use <- y_lim * 1.08

  # place labels slightly inward from panel edges
  x_annot <- x_lim * 0.97
  y_annot <- y_lim_use * 0.95

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = log2FC, y = negLog10FDR)) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(alpha_fdr),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(-fc_cut, fc_cut),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = plot_class),
      size = 2.8,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = lab_df,
      aes(label = Parameter, color = class),
      size = 3.3,
      box.padding = 0.35,
      point.padding = 0.2,
      segment.alpha = 0.5,
      segment.size = 0.3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = x_annot,
      y = y_annot,
      label = "Higher in pCR",
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 3.8,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = -x_annot,
      y = y_annot,
      label = "Higher in RD",
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 3.8,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Growth rate"     = "green3",
        "Inhibition rate" = "red3",
        "Dynamic feature" = "blue3",
        "Not significant" = "grey70"
      ),
      breaks = c("Growth rate", "Inhibition rate", "Dynamic feature"),
      name = "Parameter class"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(-x_lim, x_lim),
      ylim = c(0, y_lim_use),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = expression(log[2]~fold~change~"(pCR / RD)"),
      y = expression(-log[10]~"(FDR)")
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.6, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
    )
}
```
